description: This file contains TypeScript code for importing and exporting functions and constants related to the XAI (Explainable AI) provider configuration, model handling, and transport resolution within the OpenClaw project. It defines utility functions to determine XAI-related endpoints and model hints, and manages external dependencies from the plugin SDK.

methods.name: function isXaiNativeEndpoint(baseUrl: unknown): boolean { isXaiNativeEndpoint
methods.description: Checks if a given base URL corresponds to an XAI native endpoint by resolving the provider endpoint and inspecting its class.

methods.name: export function isXaiModelHint(modelId: string): boolean { isXaiModelHint
methods.description: Determines if a model ID has an XAI provider hint.

methods.name: function shouldUseXaiResponsesTransport(params: { shouldUseXaiResponsesTransport
methods.description: Decides whether to use the XAI responses transport based on provider parameters.

methods.name: export function shouldContributeXaiCompat(params: { shouldContributeXaiCompat
methods.description: Checks whether to contribute XAI compatibility features based on model information.

methods.name: export function resolveXaiTransport(params: { resolveXaiTransport
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate XAI transport configuration if applicable.
